answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the hollow funding graph is rebuilt from the yarrow history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 141 bonds yet holds one position, and the gale report publishes the merged exposure. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 141 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
